full_prompt_en: A square Japanese woodblock-inspired illustration depicts a solitary woman in a dark kimono standing before an immense ivory moon. Muted grey-green surrounds the pale disc, which extends from near the top edge into the lower right of the composition. Its softly uneven surface has faint mottled and curling marks, with little tonal modelling. A cluster of thin bare branches rises along the left border, while a separate slender twig crosses the lower-right portion of the moon. The woman stands left of centre in right-facing profile, her head slightly bowed. A broad brown straw hat forms a tilted oval above her dark hair, its underside shaded and its rim clearly silhouetted against the moon. A small pale area of her face is visible beneath the brim. Her long blue-black robe widens slightly towards the ground, with a few subdued blue-green folds describing the sleeves and draped fabric. One visible hand is held near the front of her waist beside a small dark hanging form. Her lower outline merges with the dense grass, leaving the feet indistinct. Long ochre and brown grasses sweep diagonally down from left to right across the foreground. Individual fine blades overlap into broad bands, interrupted by flat pale green gaps and patches of the underlying surface. The grasses make a low sloping shape beneath the upright figure and the large circular disc. Fine charcoal contours, gently weathered colour fields and subtle paper-like texture give the image a restrained printed quality. The moon supplies the broad luminous background; the figure remains mostly in shadow, with only small lighter accents on the face and hat. Grey-green, ivory, ochre and blue-black hold the composition together, balancing delicate linear detail with large quiet shapes in a still nocturnal scene.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形日本木版画风格插画，一位身穿深色和服的女子独自站在巨大的象牙白圆月前。柔和灰绿色环绕月面，浅色圆盘从接近画面顶部一直延伸至右下方。月面色调变化很少，略显不均匀的表面带有淡淡斑驳与卷曲纹理。左边缘升起一簇纤细裸枝，另有一根独立细枝穿过圆月右下部。女子位于中心偏左，侧脸朝右，头部微微低垂。宽棕色草帽在深色头发上方形成倾斜椭圆，帽底较暗，帽沿在月面前留下清楚剪影。帽檐下露出一小片浅色脸部。蓝黑长袍向地面略微展开，少量含蓄蓝绿色褶皱交代袖子与垂落布料。一只可见的手停在腰部前方，旁边有一个小型深色垂挂形体。人物下部轮廓融入密集草丛，脚部难以辨认。赭色与棕色长草在前景由左上斜向右下铺展，纤细草叶互相重叠成宽带，其间露出平涂的浅绿色空隙与底层表面。草丛在直立人物与巨大圆盘下方形成低缓斜坡。炭灰细轮廓、轻微斑驳的色面和细腻纸质纹理构成克制的印刷质感。圆月提供宽阔明亮背景，人物大部分仍处于暗部，脸和帽子上只有少量浅色点缀。灰绿、象牙白、赭色与蓝黑统一画面，使精细线条与宽阔安静的形体在静止夜景中取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The style uses flat, carefully bounded colour areas, delicate contour drawing, and a lightly mottled print surface. Narrow dark lines describe fine structures, while broad unmodulated shapes preserve quiet open fields. Muted green-grey and blue-black sit beside warm ochre and ivory; the largest pale mass establishes the dominant visual weight. Texture remains subtle and uneven rather than glossy or heavily grainy. Backlighting separates a dark silhouette from a luminous plane without modelling every surface. The composition favours simple vertical forms, one broad circular area, and a diagonal boundary. This restrained balance gives the image a poetic stillness and lets a few strong shapes carry the scene.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格以边界清楚的平涂色块、纤细轮廓线和轻微斑驳的印刷表面为特征。深色细线描写精细结构，宽阔而少有变化的色块则保留安静的留白。灰绿与蓝黑色紧邻暖赭色和象牙白，最大的一片浅色形体形成主要视觉重量。肌理细微且不均匀，不显光滑，也没有粗重颗粒。逆光将深色剪影从明亮色面中分离，却不对每个表面进行复杂塑形。构图偏好简洁竖向形态、一片宽阔圆形区域和斜向边界。克制的平衡带来诗意静气，让少量鲜明形状承担主要画面表现。
theme_en: A woman in a kimono beneath a large full moon
theme_zh: 大月亮下身着和服的女子
name: Bertha Lum
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
